profile.headline: Software Developer at Metropolitan Transportation Authority
profile.summary:
Full stack software engineer with 3+ years building and optimizing .NET, C#, and Angular applications for large-scale government systems. Experienced in SQL/Oracle performance tuning, automated testing and leading engineering teams. Started in Electrical Engineering before moving into software.

Languages & Frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C#, SQL, HTML, CSS, React (Redux/React Native), Angular, Node.js, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Razor Pages, Entity Framework, Express
Databases & Backend: PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL (MongoDB, Firebase), Oracle, T-SQL, Sequelize, RESTful APIs
Tools & Testing: Playwright, Jest, Selenium, CI/CD (GitHub/Jenkins), Power BI, Agile, Scrum
